lead: 今天練的是把站會分成三種說話類型：純更新、需要當場拍板的決定、以及更正自己上週講錯的數字。多數人只會第一種，於是會議開完沒有決議、錯誤也沒被修掉。每個 speaking 段落請先出聲講完再看 model answer。

phrases.en: Compared with last Monday, the one thing that changed is…
phrases.gl: 跟上週比，唯一改變的是……（用「差異」開場，比重講一次全貌快十倍）
phrases.ex: Compared with last Monday, the one thing that changed is storage — we burned 40% of the month's budget in six days.

phrases.en: That's tracking, so I'll skip it.
phrases.gl: 這條照計畫走，我就跳過（主動放棄發言時間，是自信的表現）
phrases.ex: Rear camera calibration is tracking, so I'll skip it — shout if you want the detail.

phrases.en: This one needs a decision today, not an update.
phrases.gl: 這件事需要今天拍板，不是報告（明確切換模式，逼出決議）
phrases.ex: This one needs a decision today, not an update: do we cap fleet uploads at 2 TB a day, or do we buy more storage?

phrases.en: I've deprioritised X so we can protect Y.
phrases.gl: 我把 X 降級，為了保住 Y（展現取捨，而不是全部都要）
phrases.ex: I've deprioritised the rainy-weather set this sprint so we can protect the cut-in recall work before the review.

phrases.en: Rough numbers, but the direction is clear:
phrases.gl: 數字還粗，但趨勢很明確（可以先講方向，不用等到精準）
phrases.ex: Rough numbers, but the direction is clear: cut-in recall is sitting around 0.71 against a target of 0.85.

phrases.en: Owner is Grace, date is Thursday.
phrases.gl: 負責人是誰、日期是哪天（一句話把 action item 釘死）
phrases.ex: We'll re-run the calibration on the new module — owner is Kevin, date is Thursday.

phrases.en: If nothing changes, this becomes a problem on Thursday.
phrases.gl: 如果什麼都不做，這件事星期四會爆（把風險綁在具體日期上）
phrases.ex: If nothing changes, this becomes a problem on Thursday — we'd walk into the review with recall well under target.
phrases.fix: 取代 “Maybe it will be a risk in the future”

phrases.gl: 更正一下星期五說的（大方修正自己的數字，可信度反而上升）
phrases.ex: Correction from Friday — I quoted recall at 0.78, but that was on the old validation split. The real number is 0.71.
phrases.fix: 取代 “Sorry sorry, last week I said wrong, please ignore that”

phrases.en: Can we hold that until Thursday's review?
phrases.gl: 這個能不能留到星期四的 review 再談？（把離題內容搬到有時間的場合）
phrases.ex: That's a real question about lens selection — can we hold that until Thursday's review, where Kevin will be in the room?

setup: Setup. Monday stand-up, six days into the sprint, and the milestone review is this Thursday. Over the weekend the fleet uploaded far more rosbag data than planned — 40% of the month's storage budget is gone in six days, and Grace on the data platform team has flagged that the shared bucket will hit its cap by Wednesday night. Separately, the new front camera module shows rolling shutter smear on highway cut-in scenes, and cut-in recall is sitting at 0.71 against a target of 0.85. You also realised on Sunday that the 0.78 recall figure you quoted on Friday came from the old validation split, so the room is currently working from a wrong number. David runs the stand-up and will decide on Thursday whether the milestone is signed off; Kevin owns the camera hardware and Vincent controls the vehicle slots.

prompts.q: David: “Momo, go ahead — and flag anything you need from us.”
prompts.frame: Delta from last week → skip what's tracking → the number that matters → the decision you need today.
prompts.say: 先出聲講完整段（目標 50 秒），開場用「跟上週比，改變的是什麼」，不要從頭複述一次專案。
prompts.model: “Compared with last Monday, the one thing that changed is storage. We pulled in a lot more highway data over the weekend than we planned for, and we're 40% through the month's budget in six days. Grace says the shared bucket caps out Wednesday night. Calibration and the labeling queue are both tracking, so I'll skip those. The number that matters this week is cut-in recall — rough numbers, but the direction is clear: we're around 0.71 against a target of 0.85, and the new front module's rolling shutter smear looks like part of the cause. I've deprioritised the rainy-weather set so we can put everything into that. And this one needs a decision today, not an update: do we cap fleet uploads at 2 TB a day and keep collecting selectively, or do we extend the storage budget? I can live with either, but I can't leave it open past tomorrow.”

prompts.q: Grace: “Why can't you just delete the old bags and free up the space yourself?”
prompts.frame: Take the suggestion seriously → name the specific cost of doing it → offer the version of it you can accept → give owner and date.
prompts.say: 出聲練習「不是拒絕，是換一個版本」——不要說 “No, it's impossible.”
prompts.model: “I'd rather not delete blind, and here's why — about a third of what's in there is the night and tunnel set, and those are the exact bags we'd need again if the review sends us back for more cut-in data. What I can do is a targeted clean-up: everything from the daytime urban runs that's already been labeled and ingested comes out, and that gets us roughly 8 TB back. That covers us to about Friday, so it buys time rather than solving it. Can you and I do that pass together tomorrow morning? Owner is me, date is Tuesday, and I'll tell David on Wednesday whether we still need the budget extension.”

prompts.q: Before you hand back, you need to correct the recall figure you gave the room on Friday. Alan is already treating 0.78 as the working number.
prompts.frame: Correct it in the first sentence → say where the wrong number came from → say what it changes → say what it doesn't change.
prompts.say: 出聲練習「更正自己」——不要用連續道歉開場，講完事實再往前走。
prompts.model: “One correction from Friday before I hand back. I quoted cut-in recall at 0.78 — that was on the old validation split, and it double-counted some of the clips we'd already trained on. On the clean split it's 0.71. So Alan, don't plan around 0.78. What that changes is the review on Thursday: we're further from target than the room thought, and I'll bring a revised plan rather than a sign-off slide. What it doesn't change is the schedule — the retrain still lands Wednesday, and I'll have the corrected numbers in the deck by Wednesday evening. That's me, back to you.”

fixes.bad: Because the bucket was almost full, so we stopped the upload on Sunday.
fixes.good: Because the bucket was almost full, we stopped the upload on Sunday.
fixes.note: Grammar（Because…, so… 句型）：中文的「因為…所以…」是一組，英文只能擇一。用 Because 開頭就不要 so；或者反過來說 “The bucket was almost full, so we stopped the upload.”

fixes.bad: We got a lot of feedbacks and useful informations from the vehicle team.
fixes.good: We got a lot of useful feedback from the vehicle team.
fixes.note: Plurals（不可數名詞）：feedback、information、progress、research、equipment 都沒有複數形，也不能說 a feedback。要數就用 a piece of feedback、three comments。

fixes.bad: Kevin will do a deeper analyze on the smear before Thursday.
fixes.good: Kevin will run a deeper analysis of the smear before Thursday.
fixes.note: Word form（詞性）：analyze 是動詞、analysis 才是名詞。同組常見錯誤：advise/advice、affect/effect、succeed/success。

fixes.bad: If the smear will be worse at high speed, we will change the sensor.
fixes.good: If the smear gets worse at high speed, we'll change the sensor.
fixes.note: Grammar（條件句）：if 子句用現在式表達未來，不放 will；will 只留給主句。這是台灣工程師在英文會議中最常被聽出來的一個結構。

fixes.bad: Vincent, you must give me two vehicle slots this week, this is very important for us.
fixes.good: Vincent, I need two vehicle slots this week — without them the cut-in re-collection can't start before the review.
fixes.note: Register（語氣）：you must 在英文會議裡是命令，聽起來越級。改成 I need + 原因，語氣不卑不亢，而且對方知道為什麼要答應你。

challenge:
今天在真實 stand-up 中做這兩件事：

  • 開場用差異，而不是複述：“Compared with last week, the one thing that changed is ___.”
  • 至少把一件事升級成需要拍板：“This one needs a decision today, not an update: ___ or ___?”

錄音作業（60 秒，手機錄）：用英文講一次你這週真實的進度，但這次刻意做三個動作。

  • 明確跳過一條線：“That's tracking, so I'll skip it.”
  • 講出一個你主動降級的項目：“I've deprioritised ___ so we can protect ___.”
  • 結尾把風險綁在日期上：“If nothing changes, this becomes a problem on ___.”
  • 禁用：Because…, so…、feedbacks、informations、if … will、you must
check: 我今天的 stand-up 是講「跟上週的差異」，還是又把整個專案複述了一遍？
我有沒有至少把一件事明確標成「需要今天決定」，而不是讓它繼續掛著？
如果我上週講錯了任何數字，我今天有沒有主動更正，而且沒有連續道歉？
